name: daydream
description: Local-first desktop recall assistant for answering "what did I do today?"
author: Felix Faust <daydream@turtledev.net>

scripts.check: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @daydream/desktop lint && yarn workspace @daydream/shared lint && yarn workspace @daydream/ffmpeg lint
scripts.lint:fix: yarn workspace @daydream/desktop lint:fix && yarn workspace @daydream/shared lint:fix && yarn workspace @daydream/ffmpeg lint:fix
scripts.test: yarn workspace @daydream/desktop test && yarn workspace @daydream/shared test && yarn workspace @daydream/ffmpeg test
scripts.test:recorder: yarn workspace @daydream/desktop test:recorder && yarn workspace @daydream/desktop test:recorder:coverage && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @daydream/desktop typecheck && yarn workspace @daydream/shared typecheck && yarn workspace @daydream/ffmpeg typecheck
